rows.63:1c5c:
I lay dozing on my bed, wrapped in that dusky gloom.
Before me was the familiar door.
...Yes, it was my own room, after all.
Of course it was familiar...
On the other side of that door, I could sense someone.
...Someone was there!
But someone... it could only be him!
Strange, isn't it?
I felt an odd certainty.
...He had come back.
Back to me, just as he promised...
That's what I believed, without the slightest doubt or fear.
<Yuya...?>
I sat up and called out softly.
And then...
<Akemi...
It's me. I've come back.
Won't you open the door?>
The answer from the other side of the door was Yuya's voice, without a doubt.
I could never mistake the voice of the one I love, could I?
...The voice went on.
<That's right.
Akemi... I promised you, didn't I?
That I'd be sure to come back to you...
Hurry, open the door.>
Of course, I did.
I wanted to see Yuya's face as soon as I could.
On unsteady legs I rose and flung the door wide open.{p}
rows.63:2e1c:
But Yoshino just wouldn't give up.
"You're lying!
There's no way you have a boyfriend☆"
...he said, and he kept pestering me.
Just then...
I felt something sway softly behind me.
Ah, Yuya is angry...
That's what I thought.
So I just let Yoshino be.
Because I knew that before long, Yuya's wrath would destroy him...
And I was right.
Yoshino jumped from the roof of the school building.
He left no note, nothing at all.
Well, if I had to give a reason, I suppose they'd call it the shock of a broken heart?
That was just three days ago...{p}
